title: p0291
universal_lens: The sport is defined as a constrained dynamical system on a bounded rectangular manifold. The prolate spheroid introduces anisotropic aerodynamic forces, while the discrete goal structure and fixed team cardinality establish a finite state space for competitive optimization.
gsi_mapping: GSI models field dimensions and goal geometry as prior constraints in a Bayesian spatial distribution of scoring probability. Team cardinality dictates the scaling of player density fields, while ball shape parameters inform conformal prediction intervals for trajectory uncertainty.
gse_mapping: GSE treats the field boundaries and goal posts as hard collision potentials in a continuous state-transition graph. Officials act as discrete event triggers resetting local game states, while the inflated bladder defines the elastic collision coefficients between agents.

primitives.name: Field Geometry Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: (a) The game shall be played upon a rectangular field, 33o feet in length and 16o feet in width, enclosed by heavy white lines marked in lime upon the ground.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: L = 330 ft (Length), W = 160 ft (Width). SI equivalent: L ≈ 100.58 m, W ≈ 48.77 m.
primitives.assumptions: Euclidean planar geometry; perfectly rigid boundary conditions at the white lines.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs if boundary markers are occluded or if the playing surface deviates significantly from a flat plane.

layer2.mapping: Maps to a bounded 2D phase space in GSE, defining the maximum spatial extent for agent trajectories and interaction kernels.
layer2.telemetry: Agent position tracking relative to boundary coordinates.

primitives.name: Team Population Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: (b) The game shall be played by two teams of eleven men each.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: N_T = 11 (Agents per team), N_Total = 22 (Total active agents). Dimensionless integers.
primitives.assumptions: All agents possess identical kinematic capabilities; no substitution dynamics altering instantaneous N.
primitives.breakdown_regime: System degeneracy when N < 11 due to ejections or injuries, altering optimal packing fractions.

layer2.mapping: Defines the particle density in GSI's spatial heatmaps and sets the branching factor for GSE's tactical tree search.
layer2.telemetry: Active player count and spatial clustering metrics.

primitives.name: Ball Shape Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: The ball shall have the shape of a prolate spheroid.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: a = semi-major axis, b = semi-minor axis. Aspect ratio k = a/b > 1. Units: meters.
primitives.assumptions: Rigid body rotation during flight; uniform mass distribution within the leather shell.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Aerodynamic model fails under extreme deflation (loss of spheroidal shape) or supersonic velocities inducing shockwaves.

layer2.mapping: Injects rotational drag tensors into GSE physics engine; informs GSI probabilistic models of pass completion based on orientation.
layer2.telemetry: Ball spin rate, orientation vector, and velocity decay.
